Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Aei Iveren: 21-year-old woman, 190 cm (very-tall), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: round full face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; prominent bridge, compact mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: hidden undercut. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a shallow cheek scar. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
